## Current objective
Continue adding request-ID-aware logging. The dunning scheduler fix is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 broke the Stripe client. Repeated per-currency invoice queries caused severe N+1 behavior.

## Recent work
Modernized timezone handling, billing session injection, imports, invoice pagination, and FastAPI dependencies; Ruff is clean and tests pass (149 passed, 2 skipped). Replaced invoice creation `print()` with structured logging. Added a safe `request_id` log-record extractor in `ledgerly/logging.py` and included `request_id` in formatter output. Relevant context support is `current_request_id` in `RequestContextMiddleware`; logging verification is still pending.
